scoring.notes: Coding sector component; the page's Component Scores note states that each benchmark column is that benchmark's own published standalone score, under the same methodology, with Code Migration as the stated exception. Unlike EMB, Code Migration and Legal Research Bench, the page does not call Vibe Code Bench a private benchmark. The page reports these columns under its "ACCURACY" view (heading "Industry Average Accuracy Comparison") and prints index values as percentages in its Key Takeaways.
